name: Spirit Gift
body:
School transmutation; Level adept 2, druid 2, medium 2, occultist 2, shaman 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, spiritualist 2, witch 2

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like fey gift, except it instead affects an incorporeal undead creature (up to 1 HD per caster level) seeking to gain entry to the protected house. Once accepted, the gift can be moved by the creature as though it had the ghost touch property.
